patches.name: stats-csv
tradeoffs: CSV is generated in memory per request: fine for per-link stats (bounded by 50 referrers and daily buckets) but not for bulk export
Formula neutralisation prefixes a quote, which alters the visible text of hostile cells instead of rejecting them

patches.name: trusted-proxy
patches.summary: Rate-limit by real client IP behind a configured trusted proxy; never trust X-Forwarded-For from untrusted peers
tradeoffs: Trust is configured by exact peer address; CIDR ranges and the standard Forwarded header are not supported
Right-most-untrusted-hop parsing assumes the proxy appends to X-Forwarded-For (standard behaviour); a proxy that overwrites it needs the same config

patches.name: analytics-retention
patches.summary: Purge per-day analytics older than a retention period, scheduled with the existing housekeeping loop
tradeoffs: Retention drops per-day buckets only; totals and referrer counts are aggregates and are kept indefinitely
Purge runs in the existing 60 s housekeeping loop: eventual, not instant, deletion
